Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 132 s. 2022 October 18, 2022 MS. IMELDA DOMINGA R. LAGRIMAS OIC, Office of the Sangguniang Panlungsod Secretary Sangguniang Panlungsod of San Pablo City 7th floor New Governance Bldg.,A.Mabini Street San Pablo City, Laguna Dear Ms. Lagrimas: This has reference to your letter dated 17 August 2022 requesting for this Department's guidance and legal opinion regarding a proposed ordinance of the Sangguniang Panlungsod of San Pablo City. One of the sections in that ordinance is the creation of the Local Youth Development Council (LY DC) which shall be composed of representatives of youth and youth- serving organizations in the city. Particularly, the issue is centered on the chairmanship Of the Local Youth Development Council whether it is allowed that the ordinance include the installation of a co-chairperson along with the Sangguniang Kabataan Pederasyon President to head this Council. At the outset, we deem it proper to highlight one of the State policies found in Section 2 of Republic Act No. 107421 that the "State shall establish adequate, effective, responsive, and enabling mechanism and support systems that will ensure the meaningful participation of the youth in local governance and in nation-buildind'. Relevant thereto, RA 10742 provides spaces for youth's participation in policy-making and governance. Section 23 thereof mandales the creation of Local Youth Development Council (LYDC) in every city, municipality and province comprised of representatives of youth and youth-serving organizations in the local goverment unit concerned. The LYDC shall assist in the planning and execution of projects and programs of the SK, and the Pederasyon in all levels. Section 23 is quoted hereunder, viz: "SEC. 23. Creation . — To ensure wide and multi-sectoral youth participation in local govemance, there shall be in every province, city and municipality a Local Youth Development Council (LYDC) "which shall be called, Provincial Youth Development Council, City Youth Development Council and Municipal Youth Development Council, respectively. The L YDC shall be composed of representatives of youth 1 An Act Establishing Reforms in the Sangguniang Kabataan Creating Enabling Mechanisms for Meaningful Youth Participation in Nation-Building, and for Other Purposes "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.; 8876-34-54

and youth-serving organizations in the provincial, city, and municipal level. The L YDC shall assist the planning and execution of projects and programs of the Sangguniang Kabataan, and the Pederasyons in all levels. " Correspondingly, paragraphs (a) and (i), Section 24 of the Implementing Rules and Reglations of RA 10742 provides for the composition and head of the LYDC, thus: "SECTION 24. Creation. — (a) To ensure wide and multi-sectoral youth participation in local govemance, there shall be in every province, city and municipality an LYDC which shall be called, Provincial Youth Development Council (PYDC), City Youth Development Council (CYDC) and Municipal Youth Development Council (MYDC), respectively. The LYDC shall be headed bv the concerned SK Pederasvon President and composed of representatives of youth and youth-serving organizations in the provincial, city, and municipal level. xxx (i) Composition of the LYDC — The LYDC shall be composed of at least ten (IO) but not more than twenty-one members including the two (2) core members from the SK. The two (2) core members shall be composed of the president and vice-president of the concemed Pederasyon and shall be supported by at least eight (8) but not more than nineteen (19) other representatives from registered youth organizations or youth serving organizations, provided that all other incumbent SK Officials shall not be eligible as member of the LYDC." Based on the foregoing provisions, it appears that installation of a co- chairperson along with the SK Federation President to head the council is authorized by RA No. 10742 — per your letter, automatic chairperson of the Council will be the SK Federation President, it follows therefore that, co-chairperson will be the SK Federation Vice President. For your further guidance, may we cite herein the requisites for a valid ordinance. The Supreme Court has ruled that in order for an ordinance to be valid in substance, it (1) must not contravene the Constitution or any statute; (2) must not be unfair or oppressive; (3) must not be partial or discriminatory; (4) must not prohibit, but may regulate trade; (5) must be general and consistent with public policy; and (6) must not be unreasonable. 2 2City of Cagayan De Oro, Petitioner, V. Cagayan Electric Power & Light Co., Inc. (CEPALCO), G.R. No. 224825, October 17, 2018. Page 2 of 3

Notwithstanding, this opinion is being issued without prejudice to any contrary opinion, decisions, and orders of competent authorities and/or the courts. We hope to have assisted you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: R. LLAMAS ATTY. reta or External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OU JVRULRALLD/jvpr copy furnish: DIR. ARIEL O.
